More controls & session notes

Tab leaves the game so you can reach page controls. M opens the automap. Enter confirms game menus; arrow keys navigate. Use the Pause button before adjusting settings.

Touch controls appear on narrow screens. Rotate your device for a larger view. Restart and applying packs begin a new game. Saves and attract-mode demos are disabled in this edition; closing the tab clears the session. Gameplay includes flashing effects.

Built on a classic.

The real id Software Doom engine, compiled to WebAssembly. Freedoom Phase 1 supplies the freely redistributable artwork, maps and audio. Made by IMD Swarm.

Original DOOM and DOOM II assets are not included. Load only files you have the right to use. Vanilla PWADs are supported; extended engines and scripted mods are not.
